content: Cefprozil Tablets USP, 250 mg, are oval-shaped, white to cream-tinged, unscored, film-coated tablets. They are debossed with 347 on one side and 250 on the reverse side. These tablets are supplied in bottles containing 100 tablets, identified by NDC 0781-5043-01. Cefprozil Tablets USP, 500 mg, are oval-shaped, beige, unscored, film-coated tablets. They are debossed with 348 on one side and 500 on the reverse side. These tablets are supplied in bottles of 50 tablets (NDC 0781-5044-50) and bottles of 100 tablets (NDC 0781-5044-01). The tablets should be stored at a controlled room temperature of 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F). They must be dispensed in a tight, light-resistant container as defined by the United States Pharmacopeia (USP). Cefprozil for Oral Suspension USP, 125 mg/5 mL, is available in the following packaging: 50 mL bottle (NDC 0781-6202-91) 75 mL bottle (NDC 0781-6202-57) 100 mL bottle (NDC 0781-6202-46) Cefprozil for Oral Suspension USP, 250 mg/5 mL, is available in the following packaging: 50 mL bottle (NDC 0781-6203-91) 75 mL bottle (NDC 0781-6203-57) 100 mL bottle (NDC 0781-6203-46) All powder formulations for oral suspension contain cefprozil in a fruity-flavored mixture. The powder itself is slightly cream-tinged to beige in color. After reconstitution, the suspension appears light orange and has a fruity odor and flavor.
